answer: Age-Weighted Participation Curve. Each identity's influence starts near zero and rises only with continuous, verifiable activity over time, like rings in a marble. An attacker must sustain many parallel identities through costly real actions for months before any gains weight; early influence is negligible. The quill of history writes slowly, so mass-registering fresh identities yields almost no voting or routing power. Honest participants accumulate standing in one orchard of effort.
